The tail current looks low. The slew rate of 8.75 V/µs into 2 pF implies about 17.5 µA of tail current, while the M5/M6 mirror (W/L ratio 2.26) would give about 22.6 µA. Lower tail current reduces gm1, which explains the low UGBW (18.9 MHz vs. 43 MHz) and the slow settling. The small offset (-1.9 mV) and near-mid-rail output point to a symmetric diff pair and load, so M1, M2, M3, and M4 are less likely. The fault is most likely in the tail mirror, with M5 undersized as the top suspect.
